learned_gradient_from_real_votes.note: actual constituency result ~ census Catholic-background% (SA->constituency); learned per contest, not assumed
learned_gradient_from_real_votes.interpretation: Nationalist-bloc vote is predicted by community background at R2~0.99 (slope ~1.0). EU-Remain is far flatter (slope 0.41). The unity gradient is bounded by these; survey unity crosstabs imply ~0.7.

learned_lucidtalk_calibration.note: LucidTalk party VI vs actual, nationalist as % of Nat+Uni (neutralises Alliance/Other volatility)
learned_lucidtalk_calibration.correction: LucidTalk is ~unbiased and accurate to ~1pt on the constitutional split; the earlier +2.9 'house effect' was an Alliance-confounded artifact and is removed.

learned_source_weights.method: inverse-variance; sigma_LT=1.0 (measured vs 4 elections), sigma_NILT=1.8 (sampling n~1000 + annual lag)
